Support the Porch

Support the Ministry

You are already welcome here — completely free, no account, no pressure. This is a Bible-teaching ministry, and giving is simply one way to help it reach more people.

KJV-only. Privacy-first. Offline-first. The daily porch is always free. Gifts fund teaching content, outreach to prisons and hospitals, and keeping the Word available for anyone who needs it — giving is never tied to access.

See the ways to help Where support goes Return to Today’s Verse

Ways to Help the Porch

Whether you give once, become a steady Porch Partner, leave a legacy, or honor someone with a memorial gift — every amount helps keep calm, trustworthy KJV tools available when someone needs them most. No pressure. You are already welcome here.

One-time Gift

$25

Keeps servers running, new Battle Plans written, and free printables going to churches and hospitals.

Porch Partner

$7/mo

Steady, monthly support that sustains teaching content creation, free outreach packs, and the porch for anyone who finds it in a hard moment. The most consistent way to help the ministry grow.

Legacy / Endowment

$500+

Help build something that outlives us — a steady endowment so the porch can support rural churches, print resources for the hurting, and one day sustain a small faithful team or ministry.

Memorial Gift

In memory or honor of a loved one. A quiet way to remember them while supporting the work they would have loved.

Where Your Gift Goes

  • Cloudflare hosting, CDN, and security hardening so the site stays fast and private even on hard days.
  • Teaching content — new Battle Plans, Bible study tracks, workbooks, pastor resources, and family tools written by hand (no AI, no filler).
  • Free outreach — printable packs to rural churches, hospitals, prisons, missionaries, and new believers who have nothing to give.
  • Ministry operations — the builder’s time, disclosed honestly. “The labourer is worthy of his reward.” — 1 Timothy 5:18.
  • Long-term endowment toward a small, faithful team that can sustain and expand the work one day.

Three quiet ways to help today

Pray

Pray that the site remains useful, clean, and faithful for every person who opens it in pain, fear, grief, or exhaustion.

Share

If this porch has helped you, quietly share the homepage, a daily verse, or a Battle Plan with one person who needs it.

Return tomorrow

Come back for the next verse, the next plan, the next quiet moment with Scripture. Your presence here is already a gift.
